product_overview: A personal portfolio website built to showcase the owner's skills, professional experience, projects, publications, and provide an interactive way for visitors to get in touch. The site features modern web technologies and interactive animations to enhance user engagement.
core_goals: Present a comprehensive overview of the owner's professional profile including skills, experience, projects, and publications.
Provide an engaging and visually appealing user interface with smooth animations and interactive 3D effects.
Facilitate easy communication through a secure and validated contact form integrated with email services.
Ensure performance optimization and responsiveness across devices with a modern tech stack.
Implement robust error handling and analytics to monitor site usage and performance.
key_features: Hero Section with animated introduction and call-to-action to welcome visitors.
About Me Section showcasing personal background and information.
Skills Section featuring an interactive 3D particle ring with animated skill logos in horizontally scrolling marquee rows.
Projects Section displaying a portfolio of projects with filtering capabilities and detailed project cards.
Experience Section presenting a professional timeline including internships and work history.
Publications Section listing academic and research publications.
Contact Section with a validated contact form using Zod schema, security sanitization, and email integration via Resend and Nodemailer.
Sticky header navigation with responsive mobile menu for easy site browsing.
Footer containing social media links and copyright information.
Animated custom cursor for enhanced user interaction.
Smooth page transitions powered by Framer Motion.
Error boundary implementation to gracefully handle React errors.
Lazy loading and optimized image components to improve loading performance.
Scroll-triggered animations and parallax effects to enrich visual storytelling.
Performance monitoring tools for Core Web Vitals, resource timing, and memory usage.
Custom analytics to track user interactions, section views, and scroll depth.
Loading optimizations including resource preloading and font optimizations.
Serverless API endpoints with rate limiting for contact form submissions.
Express backend server supporting API handling.
Progressive Web App features via service worker for offline support and caching.
Interactive UI components like Like Button, Certification Card, and Skill Badge for enhanced engagement.
user_flow_summary: Visitors land on the site and are greeted by the Hero Section with animated introduction and call-to-action.
Users navigate the site via the sticky header that adapts to mobile devices with a responsive menu.
Users explore the About Me section to learn about the owner's background and personal info.
Users interact with the Skills Section featuring a 3D particle ring and scrolling skill logos to quickly grasp competencies.
Users filter and browse Projects in the Projects Section and read detailed information on each project card.
Professional experience is presented in a vertical timeline format for easy consumption of work history and internships.
Academic and research publications are listed for visitors interested in the owner's scholarly work.
Visitors can smoothly scroll through sections with animated transitions and scroll-triggered effects enhancing engagement.
Users utilize the Contact Section to send messages through a validated and secure contact form integrated with backend APIs.
Interactive elements like custom cursors and Like Buttons enrich the browsing experience.
validation_criteria: All major sections (Hero, About Me, Skills, Projects, Experience, Publications, Contact) must render correctly and be fully responsive.
Animations including 3D particle ring, marquee scrolling, page transitions, and scroll animations should perform smoothly without significant frame drops.
Contact form must validate input data using Zod schemas and sanitize inputs to prevent security issues.
Email functionality should be tested end-to-end ensuring messages are sent successfully using Nodemailer or Resend services.
Navigation menus (desktop and mobile) must function correctly with sticky behavior and responsiveness.
Performance metrics should meet Core Web Vitals standards and memory leaks should be monitored and addressed.
Lazy loading and image optimization components should accurately load assets without visual glitches.
Error boundaries should capture React errors gracefully and provide fallback UI without crashing the app.
Analytics data for user interactions and scroll depth must be captured and reported correctly.
Serverless API endpoints for contact form should enforce rate limiting and handle failures robustly.
Service worker should provide offline support and cache resources effectively for PWA behavior.
